## Checklist

- [ ] YAML lives at `skins/<name>.yaml` and the file's `name:` field matches the filename
- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate_skins.py` passes locally
- [ ] Screenshot committed at `screenshots/<name>.png` (or a clear note if you can't generate one)
- [ ] Added a row to the gallery table in `README.md`
- [ ] No copyrighted character names or trademarked logos; archetypes only
